question.problem:
Which of the following statements are true?

I. $\operatorname{csc}⁡{22}^{∘}=\operatorname{csc}⁡(\frac{11\pi }{90})$

II. $\operatorname{csc}⁡{94}^{∘}=\operatorname{csc}⁡(\frac{37\pi }{90})$

III. $\operatorname{csc}⁡{76}^{∘}=\operatorname{csc}⁡(\frac{19\pi }{25})$
question.worked_solution:
Let's examine the statements one by one.

- Statement I is true. Converting ${22}^{∘}$ from degrees to radians, we get

$$
{22}^{∘}=22\cdot \frac{\pi }{180}=\frac{11\pi }{90}\,\text{radians}.
$$

- Statement II is false. Converting ${94}^{∘}$ from degrees to radians, we get

$$
{94}^{∘}=94\cdot \frac{\pi }{180}=\frac{47\pi }{90}\,\text{radians}.
$$

The statement is false because $\frac{47\pi }{90}\ne \frac{37\pi }{90}.$

- Statement III is false. Converting ${76}^{∘}$ from degrees to radians, we get 

$$
{76}^{∘}=76\cdot \frac{\pi }{180}=\frac{19\pi }{45}\,\text{radians}.
$$

The statement is false because $\frac{19\pi }{45}\ne \frac{19\pi }{25}.$

So, the correct answer is 'I only'.
